places.name: St. Mark’s Basilica
places.ai_summary: A stunning cathedral known for its Italo-Byzantine architecture, mosaics, and the Pala d’Oro altarpiece.
places.cost: Free (additional fees for museum and terrace)

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and closures.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid long queues.

places.name: Doge’s Palace
places.ai_summary: A historic palace that served as the residence of the Doge of Venice, featuring Gothic architecture and the Bridge of Sighs.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Secret Itineraries tour.

places.name: Grand Canal
places.ai_summary: The main waterway of Venice, lined with historic buildings and best explored via gondola or vaporetto.

opening_hours.notes: Best experienced during sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Take a gondola ride for a unique perspective.

places.name: Rialto Bridge
places.ai_summary: The oldest bridge across the Grand Canal, known for its iconic arch and vibrant market area.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunrise or sunset.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Rialto Market for a local experience.

places.ai_summary: The principal public square of Venice, known for its stunning architecture, cafes, and the Campanile bell tower.
places.cost: Free (additional fees for Campanile and museums)
places.place_tip: Climb the Campanile for a panoramic view of Venice.

places.place_tip: Take a gondola ride to pass under the bridge.

places.name: Murano Island (Glassmaking)
places.ai_summary: Famous for its glassmaking industry, Murano Island is a short boat ride from Venice and offers a glimpse into traditional Venetian craftsmanship.
places.cost: Free (glassmaking demonstrations may have a fee)
places.place_tip: Visit a glass factory to see artisans at work.

places.name: Burano Island (Colorful Houses)
places.ai_summary: Known for its brightly colored houses and lace-making tradition, Burano Island is a picturesque destination a short boat ride from Venice.
places.place_tip: Try to visit a lace shop to see the artisans at work.

places.place_tip: Bring your own beach umbrella and snacks.
